children: LAUNCHES AN OFFERING OF CONVERTIBLE BONDS IN AN AGGREGATE AMOUNT OF EUR 600 MILLION DUE 2031
BONDS REDEEMED AT MATURITY ON SEPT 16, 2031 AT 105.84%-108.53% OF PRINCIPAL
BONDS ISSUED AT 100% OF PRINCIPAL, BEAR 0.50% INTEREST PER ANNUM
INITIAL CONVERSION PRICE SET AT 30%-35% PREMIUM ABOVE REFERENCE SHARE PRICE
SETTLEMENT EXPECTED ON SEPT 16, 2026; TO APPLY FOR TRADING ON FRANKFURT OPEN MARKET
NET PROCEEDS TO BE USED FOR GENERAL CORPORATE PURPOSES INCLUDING DEBT REFINANCING
